native_path: Python SDK constructor arguments. The README also documents a persistent patch at $DSH_HOME/profiles/sdk/cordis.patch.yml, which this example does not use.
invocation: with DeepSeekHarness(**native_config) as h: result = h.run(task_text, session_id="A04-001"); read result.final_response and result.finish_reason
limitations: Argument names and the `deepseek-official` provider route come from the SDK README, which demonstrates `deepseek-v4-flash`. The `deepseek-v4-pro` pair is not shown there and the model ID is under lifecycle change.
Public preview. MCP, memory and worktree handling appear only as community plugins, which get no weight here. Treat as an alternate, never the only path.
Provider routes for Kimi or other fallbacks depend on the chosen composition and are not documented in the README.
The community omo emulation plugin was not evaluated. No install, load or dry-run was executed.
role_binding: DSH executes one author seat per SDK session in an isolated worktree. The matrix model chain is applied by the caller (retry with the next rung on failure); DSH has no omo fallback logic.

profiles.ultimate: Alternate for A01 and A04. First rung deepseek-v4-pro, next rung kimi-k3 through a separate provider route.
profiles.hybrid: Alternate for A01 and A04. First rung gpt-5.6-terra is not DSH-native, so treat it as unavailable unless a provider route exists.
profiles.b4b: Same limitation as hybrid for the OpenAI rung.
profiles.global: Alternate for A01 and A04 with the same caveat for non-DeepSeek rungs.
